player_prompt.intro:
Tqadart {color} g umukris n Breakthrough. Tqadart {direction} ɣef tablart {board_size}x{board_size}.
G wakud-ik, tzemrart ad tawḍeḍ takarḍa yan uṭṭun s-iffas neɣ s-iffas-azɣan.
Takarḍa tzemrart ad tawḍeḍ azɣan iɣ tlla takarḍa n umukris-ak, d ad tawḍeḍ ɣef takarḍa-nna s-iffas-azɣan.
Iɣ tawḍeḍ ɣef takarḍa-nna tlla takarḍa n umukris-ak, tzemrart ad tkaṭeḍ-t d ad t-yawḍeḍ ɣef tablart.
Sqedcet tabṭit UCI, zund [a2a3] ad tawḍeḍ ɣef a2 s a3.
* 'a' ittuqqad ɣef tawla-nna tamaẓẓayt, '1' ittuqqad ɣef tawla-nna tamaẓẓayt (zund tawla-nna n Umellal).
* Tawla-nna tamaẓẓayt n Abyaḍ ittuqqad ɣef tawla-nna tafellayt (tawla 8 ɣef tablart 8x8). Tawla-nna tamaẓẓayt n Umellal ittuqqad ɣef tawla-nna tamaẓẓayt (tawla 1 ɣef tablart 8x8).
Aylli ittuqqad ɣef tawla-nna tamaẓẓayt n umukris-ak, ittuqqad. Iɣ tkkat-t takarḍa-nnek, tzemrart ad tgaḍeḍ.
